source: authored in-tree for the Facturae InvoiceTotals mapping work
notes: Hand-authored Facturae 3.2.2 invoice, fictional data, carrying the two optional total terms every other specimen in this corpus omits: an IRPF retencion (TaxTypeCode 04, 15% of a 1000.00 base) and a suplido (ReimbursableExpenses 45.00, stated both as the itemised block and as the TotalReimbursableExpenses aggregate). Synthetic is acceptable here ONLY because the schema itself now grounds what these totals must contain: the bundled facturae-3-2-2-invoice-totals.json extract carries InvoiceTotals' element sequence and each element's own xs:documentation, so the arithmetic below is the format's stated arithmetic rather than the author's understanding of it. Without that artefact this fixture would be a fixture built from what the code does. The numbers are therefore checkable against the extract rather than against this file's author. InvoiceTotal is 1060.00 = TotalGrossAmountBeforeTaxes 1000.00 + TotalTaxOutputs 210.00 - TotalTaxesWithheld 150.00, exactly as the schema documents it, which makes it NEITHER the codebase's invoice total (1255.00, gross of retencion and inclusive of the suplido) NOR its cash figure. TotalExecutableAmount is 1105.00 and equals the codebase's cash, total minus retencion, which is the independent cross-check: the reader derives the total from base plus TotalTaxOutputs plus suplidos and never reads TotalExecutableAmount, so the two agreeing is two routes reaching one figure rather than one figure restated. Before the mapping landed, a reader taking InvoiceTotal as the printed total understated this document by exactly its 150.00 retencion and the arithmetic-closure check refused it, which is the over-refusal direction on the commonest Spanish professional invoice there is.
